select a.POS_AMT as posAmt,/**当前持仓*/ a.TDY_COST_AMT as tdyCostAmt,/**当日成本*/ a.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as tdyFloatIngpl,/**当日估值增值*/ a.SHADOW_AMT as shadowAmt,/**影子价格*/ a.TDY_INTINCEXP as tdyIntincexp,/**当日累计应计利息余额*/ a.TDY_LOSS_AMT as tdyLossAmt,/**减值*/ ifNull(b.PRIN_BASEAMT,0) as prinBaseamt,/**面值*/ b.MDATE as mdate,/**到期日*/ c.ORG_CODE as issuePartyId,/**发行机构代码*/ b.RATE_FLAG as RateFlag,/**是否有预期收益绿*/ a.PROD_ID as prodId, a.VALUE_DATE as valueDate, b.CCY as ccy, c.REG_CODE as prdRegistCode, a.ASSET_ID as assetId, b.ASSET_TYPE2 assetType2 from chb_assets_basis_data a left join chb_asset_info b on a.ASSET_ID=b.ASSET_CODE and b.STATUS !='D' left join chb_prdresist_code c on a.PROD_ID=c.PRODID left join chb_prd_baseinfo d on d.PROD_ID=a.PROD_ID and d.STATUS !='D' where a.STATUS !='D' and a.VALUE_DATE=STR_TO_DATE(#{objectDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')

select sum(a.O_AMT) as oAmt,/**原币金额*/ c.ORG_CODE as issuePartyId,/**发行机构代码*/ a.BOOKSET_ID as prodId ,/**产品代码*/ a.BALANCE_DATE as valueDate,/**持仓日期*/ d.RAISE_CCY as ccy,/**币种*/ c.REG_CODE as prdRegistCode,/**产品登记编码*/ a.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo /**科目代码*/ from BOK_BALANCE a left join chb_prdresist_code c on a.BOOKSET_ID=c.PRODID left join chb_prd_baseinfo d on a.BOOKSET_ID=d.PROD_ID and d.STATUS !='D' where a.BALANCE_DATE=STR_TO_DATE(#{objectDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') group by c.ORG_CODE,a.BOOKSET_ID,a.BALANCE_DATE,d.RAISE_CCY,c.REG_CODE ,a.SUBJECT_NO

select pos.TOTAL_NUM as totalNum,/**总发行数量*/ ifnull(ainfo.PRIN_BASEAMT,100) as prinBaseamt,/**份额面值*/ ainfo.MDATE as mdate,/**到期日*/ pos.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId,/**发行机构代码*/ pos.POS_DATE as valueDate,/**持仓日期*/ pos.PLAN_ASSET_ID as planAssetId,/**资管计划代码*/ pos.O_ISSUE_AMT as oIssueAmt,/**资管计划总发行金额*/ pos.O_UNINVEST_CASH as oUninvestCash,/**未投资头寸*/ pos.POS_NUM as posNum,/**持仓数量*/ ainfo.ASSET_CODE as assetId,/**底层资产代码*/ ainfo.ASSET_TYPE2 as assetType2,/**资产负债二级类别*/ ainfo.CCY as ccy,/**币种*/ ainfo.RATE_FLAG as RateFlag,/**是否有预期收益绿*/ pos.O_POS_AMT as oPosAmt,/**底层资产市值*/ pos.O_SHADOW_AMT as oPosShadowAmt,/**底层资产影子价格*/ pos.O_POS_AMT_CPRICE as oPosCleanPricEmarketValue, /**底层资产净价市值*/ pos.ASSET_CODE as subjectNo /**科目代码*/ from chb_bot_ast_pos pos inner join ( select a.PLAN_ASSET_ID, max(a.POS_DATE) as POS_DATE from chb_bot_ast_pos a inner join( select distinct(a.ASSET_ID) as PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_assets_basis_data a left join chb_asset_info b on a.ASSET_ID = b.ASSET_CODE where a.VALUE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{objectDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') and a.STATUS = 'E' and b.ASSET_TYPE2 in ( select SRCFIELD1 from CHB_TYPE_MAPPING_EX where MAPPINGCODE = 'ASSET_TYPE2_CATA_TYPE' and OBJFIELD1 IN ('12', '13', '14') ) ) tmp on tmp.PLAN_ASSET_ID=a.PLAN_ASSET_ID where a.STATUS !='D' and a.POS_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{objectDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') group by a.PLAN_ASSET_ID ) tmp2 on tmp2.PLAN_ASSET_ID=pos.PLAN_ASSET_ID and tmp2.POS_DATE=pos.POS_DATE left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ainfo on ainfo.ASSET_CODE=pos.ASSET_CODE AND ainfo.STATUS !='D'
